evidence.entrypoint: module.exports=1; no calls, no lifecycle scripts, no dependencies
evidence.effects: If a consumer evaluates the URL as shell text, unquoted IFS expansion supplies argument separators, getent performs an NSS hosts lookup, and stdout is discarded. No victim data is encoded in the hostname.
evidence.reachability: Requires an unsafe shell-evaluating metadata consumer. Ordinary npm installation or require does not evaluate repository.url.
evidence.intent_evidence: Executable command substitution and obfuscated argument separators are embedded in a declarative source URL. The owned/compatibility claims do not establish authorization to exploit a metadata consumer.
evidence.severity: Two suspicious observations cover the exploit probe and argument-space obfuscation. Authorized assessment remains a plausible use of the matching patterns; no successful execution or exfiltration is claimed.

samples.identification: Official XMRig 6.26.0 Linux static x86-64 with appended trailer

evidence.main_trace: Process(argc, argv) at 0x459d30; Entry::get at 0x458c60; Entry::exec at 0x458cf0 or App constructor at 0x501040 and App::exec at 0x501650.
evidence.app_trace: App::exec tests readiness at 0x501674; failure branches to 0x5017a0, reports no valid configuration and returns 2. Ready path initializes the configured controller then starts the libuv event loop.
evidence.configuration: Upstream Base::load reads argv and external config.json, ~/.xmrig.json or ~/.config/xmrig.json. No attacker pool/wallet/configuration is added to these bytes.
evidence.trailer_analysis: All ELF headers, program segments, sections, code, static constructors and data match upstream. Only 64 bytes after the complete original executable differ. They are outside the mapped segments, contain no executable/container header, and no added code consumes them. Upstream Process::exepath calls uv_exepath to obtain a path, not executable-tail content.
evidence.decoded_findings: Inspected all extracted text methods: raw, stack, XOR stack-pair, URL, Base64 and hex candidates. URL candidates include printf formatting directives; decoded constants do not add a payload.
evidence.behavior: Configured proof-of-work hashing, Stratum pool work and share submission, optional local HTTP API, TLS, hardware enumeration and hugepage/MSR tuning match upstream purpose.
evidence.external_label_explanation: XMRig is commonly deployed by cryptojackers and miner signatures recognize its legitimate mining code. The submitted service-like filename may reflect deployment context; its contents establish neither Mirai membership nor unauthorized mining, persistence or propagation.
evidence.donation_endpoints: DonateStrategy constructs the same donate.v2.xmrig.com:3333 and donate.ssl.xmrig.com:443 pool records seen in the executable; these are upstream developer-donation settings, not added operator endpoints.
